column3: “Kings of covenant loyalty” is rendered “merciful kings,” and “let your life live” as “save your life.”
“Let my soul live” is rendered “let me live.”
The Hebrew is obscure (“they observed signs … caught whether from him”); NASB renders “took this as an omen, and quickly catching his word.”
“Here you are about to go” is rendered “as soon as you have departed.”
“Struck him, striking and wounding” is rendered “struck him, wounding him.”
The Hebrew בָּאֲפֵר is rendered “a bandage.”
“Doing here and here” is rendered “busy here and there.”
“The man of my total destruction” is rendered “the man whom I had devoted to destruction.”
